discription: A percussive, pluck-like sound generated using frequency modulation, ideal for string or bell-like timbres.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, modRatio=1.5, modDepth=1000, atk=0.005, rel=0.7; var sig, env, modFreq; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.perc(atk, rel, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); modFreq = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio) * (modDepth * env); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq + modFreq) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan)); }
